description: This HTML file defines the frontend interface for a database viewer web application, including layout, styles, and client-side JavaScript for dynamic interactions such as fetching database and table data, rendering tables, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections and UI states.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database's table list when clicked.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a specific database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders HTML for the data table, including headers and rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual table cell content, handling different data types and truncation.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands a cell to show full content or collapses it to truncated view.
